description.narrative: The proposed project aims to improve access to markets, climate change resilience of family farmers, and access to safe water in selected rural areas. The project will benefit mostly small-scale family farmers, indigenous people, and traditional communities.
To increase market access, agricultural productivity and develop resilience of family farmers to shocks while expanding access to resilient water services in selected rural areas.
